verdict.rationale: Crossplane's control plane reacts automatically to state changes. It corrects drift from desired state on its own, runs active controllers that respond to failures, and lets users define composition function pipelines in YAML, KCL, Python or Go in place of hand-written controllers. A feature flag also enables real-time compositions that respond to changes. However, this is declarative reconciliation rather than user-authored event-to-action rules, and the real-time mode is opt-in. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of user-defined event-triggered rules or actions, details of which events trigger functions, evidence that real-time compositions are stable rather than flag-gated, and hands-on corroboration.
